title: Basically Vanilla+
description: a resource pack that includes almost vanilla feel to it so you can enjoy much better experience. shine your way through with a new HUD change whilst vanilla !
body:
# keep it vanilla !

This resource pack retextures bad textures made by mojand people have hated over the years. We went through all the feedback and made choices that stay true to vanilla

## What we added this update:
1. new look for axes 
2. deepslate block and its variants retextured.
3. all Wool retextured
4. retexture to the sword and the pickaxe

### what might be coming next version
1. More log variants
2. More and More blocks retexture
3. items retextured to match pvp style for our sweaty fellas
4. no carved pumpkin texture on your face when you equip it !
5. Survival inventory (dont think is coming)
6. seperating the resource pack to 2 version (for connected glass pane fix)
